fields.context: Markdown, the terminal and the page each had their renderer: three walks of the same blocks, three ways of saying a status or an overlap, and the page's outside the graph.
fields.consequences: The words of a document are said once, by the renderer; a new format is a realization of a syntax port and a choice, without touching the renderer. Syntax and figures vary apart: Markdown with figures as text is two choices, not a new renderer. A project that declares a port of its own for another audience (Trame's page) gives the same renderer its syntax.
